title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：slave　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 slave 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the clerk ① freeed the slave that no applicant in the office would have noted, and he said the freeing was the whole of the month. The ② slave, meaning the servant itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed unnoted in the book; a slave, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ slave in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ slave at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A slave, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the clerk said the noting is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the slave was the whole of the matter, meaning the shame and not the servant. The ⑥ slave, meaning the shame and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; slave, he said, is either something you free or the only word that means both a servant and a shame. He said the shame is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ slave had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ slave of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of noting; slave, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ slave I remember is the servant noted in the file, which closed in 1978 and is still noted as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ slave, my mother said in 1980, is the only servant that improves by being noted; every slave, she said, is a shame that has agreed to look like a servant. She said the shame was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 奴隶（指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 奴隶（指那个奴隶本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：free the slave 解放这一个奴隶
D. n. 奴隶（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 奴隶之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的奴隶之事）
F. n. 奴隶（指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 奴隶、屈辱（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 屈辱（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: freeed the slave that no applicant in the office would have noted
The slave, meaning the servant itself and not the stamp
the slave at the far counter
the slave was the whole of the matter
the slave had become a line in a file
The slave of the whole thing
A slave, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: free the slave 意为“解放这一个奴隶”，1971 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯记下的一个奴隶做了一遍。
slave 意为“奴隶”，指那个奴隶本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记下。
slave 意为“奴隶”，指办事处里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
slave 意为“奴隶”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
slave 意为“奴隶、屈辱”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个屈辱就是那件事的全部。
slave 意为“屈辱”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个奴隶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
slave 意为“奴隶”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1976 年这一个成了卷宗里的一行。
slave 意为“奴隶之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的奴隶之事是一处办事处和三个月份的记下。
slave 意为“奴隶”，我记得的是卷宗里记下过的那一个，1978 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一个。
slave 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，奴隶是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的奴隶。
